profile.name: Jhon Eric V. Arbas
profile.intro: Entry-level Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience developing academic applications, web systems, IoT solutions, and an operational Purchase Requisition System.
about: Hi, I'm Jhon Eric V. Arbas — an entry-level Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience developing academic applications, web systems, IoT solutions, and an operational Purchase Requisition System.

Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, Visual Basic, Django, HTML, CSS, Git/GitHub, databases, and application development. Experienced in building application features, working with data and workflows, testing, troubleshooting, and collaborating in project teams.
Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while actively strengthening independent programming and software engineering skills. Currently seeking an Associate Software Engineer opportunity.

safealert-web.title: SafeAlert Web App
safealert-web.overview: SafeAlert Web App is the central monitoring and emergency dispatch dashboard for an IoT-based wearable fall detection system.
features: Contributed across front-end/UI, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, backend, database/SQL, authentication, APIs, dashboard, testing, documentation, and system integration.
Worked on the system flow from wearable fall detection through information transmission, application receipt, alert display, and emergency response.
Used AI-assisted development to support implementation, troubleshooting, and project completion.

safealert-band.title: SafeAlert Band
safealert-band.category: IoT Fall Detection and Emergency Response System
safealert-band.overview: Wearable IoT device designed to automatically detect falls in vulnerable individuals and transmit real-time alerts.
features: Worked across Arduino programming, sensor integration, hardware, testing, troubleshooting, and system components with AI assistance.
Worked with sensor values, variables, conditions, Arduino libraries, device communication, and hardware integration.

todolist.title: To-Do List
todolist.overview: A dynamic task management web application built with Django and Python.
features: Built a school project using Django and Python with AI assistance.
Worked with models/database, views, templates, URL routing, forms, CRUD functionality, Django admin, authentication, database connectivity, and debugging.

budgetpal.title: BudgetPal
budgetpal.overview: Personal budgeting and transaction application designed for expense and income management.
features: Contributed to a Visual Basic school group project as the backend/database contributor.
Worked on the database component of a financial budgeting application.

foxlearn.title: Fox Learn
foxlearn.overview: A comprehensive e-learning application interface designed in Figma with high-fidelity screens and prototypes.
features: Designed an e-learning application interface in Figma using wireframes, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, components, Auto Layout, variants, design-system elements, responsive/mobile designs, and user flows.

experience.title: Data Analyst Intern

Developed the PRS workflow covering employee requests, submission, approval, processing/status tracking, and PDF/document generation. Built and configured application views, forms, tables/data sources, relationships, actions/buttons, workflows/automation, user permissions, dashboards, and reports. Used AppSheet expressions and formulas with AI assistance and implemented PDF export functionality. Used Excel for data processing and functions, and worked with Google Apps Script with AI assistance. Assisted with computer hardware setup, Windows troubleshooting, PC assembly, hardware installation, and printer setup.
